text:
alex: Heads-up, I ran a preview for shifting 15% traffic to model-D on /translate and the preview shows a big cost delta but staging replay is tiny.
rina: Thats the fast estimator again. It ignores coalescing and prefix cache which matters for translate.
owen: We also saw sampling skew: preview sampling picks a time window that overrepresents long responses. Need deterministic trace window selection.
ux-sam: UX suggestion: show both quick and replay numbers, label them clearly, and surface a confidence interval. Dont block the users ability to continue with a promoted dry-run.
metrics-bot: preview-bot: enqueued replay job 1799001234. ETA ~28s. replay will emit replay_trace_id and confidence interval.
alex: API change proposal: /v1/preview -> return {preview_job_id, quick_estimate, links:[ops_playbook], replay_status_url}. When replay done include {final_estimate, ci, per_model_quota_headroom, replay_trace_id, telemetry_recommendations}.
rina: For quota headroom include per-route and per-quantum (per-model per-region) breakdowns. If any headroom <10% tag as high-risk.
owen: Also add the cohort-hash-version and trace_window_id in the preview metadata so replays are reproducible.
ux-sam: UI note: place telemetry recommendations in a collapsible "Ops guidance" card with a copy cmd button that prints suggested curl commands to apply temporary sampling overrides.
metrics-bot: preview-bot: replay complete. final_estimate +1.6% (ci -0.7..+3.4). replay_trace_id=rt-2026-11-21-179900.
alex: Great. Action items: owen wire deterministic trace window + preview_job_id, rina add per-model headroom and risk tag, ux-sam mock ops card and dual estimate display.
